data.text/html:
Unsupervised subcategory clusters

The raw subcategory text is clustered into 14 semantic groups with cosine-based spherical k-means. The supplied category headings are used only after clustering to name each group and calculate purity, so they cannot leak into the features. The first run embeds the raw labels through OpenAI and stores them in the existing local cache.

Seed groups by variation

The seeds already carry their subcategory in the variation: frontmatter, so there is nothing to discover with k-means: each tag is its own group. Embedding measures how far apart the seeds within a subcategory landed — a high mean pairwise cosine means that subcategory produced near-duplicates.
261 variation groups over 1048 seeds. Sorted tightest first — the top rows are the subcategories whose seeds repeat each other.
